statement: The residual register wall may be reachable with a per-function optimizer PRAGMA rather than a source-shape edit. Candidate #1: wrap KartState::updateCollisions (or just its head) with '#pragma opt_common_subs off' (+ matching pop/on). Rationale, grounded in the existing evidence: (a) the field notes' confirmed ~14 structural slots / 4-instruction size gap are explicitly CSE-locked ('CSE merges all (u8)playerIdx forms into one clrlwi'); opt_common_subs is the exact pass responsible, so turning it off is the direct control for that gap. (b) The colour wall is a frontend vreg-numbering/coalescing artefact: retail's pe is a long-lived temp numbered ABOVE the rodata pool (so it colours r30 before the pool's r29), while ours is a declared local pinned at v69 BELOW the pool (v88) and therefore always colours r28. Adding/removing CSE'd and copy-propagated temps changes the compiler-temp creation order and count, i.e. the vreg block that decides this order; opt_common_subs off (and, as fallbacks, opt_propagation off / global_optimizer off / opt_lifetimes off / opt_usedef_mem_limit) are the only untried levers that can renumber temps without changing source semantics. Measure by diffing match_percent plus regalloc dump (pe/pool var_r28 vreg ids and colours) for each pragma around the function.
